verdict.rationale: CSC's own marketing says its entity management platform supports "secure bi-directional integrations with enterprise and third-party systems via modern APIs" [csc-docs-16]. It also says service-of-process integrations with ELM, claims, and payroll systems run through secure APIs [csc-docs-5]. That gives a vendor-claimed API capability, but nothing shows it is public or documented, and probes for llms.txt and OpenAPI/Swagger specs all returned 404 [csc-probe-1, csc-probe-2]. Missing for 10: publicly documented API reference, evidence of read/write endpoints for entity records, evidence of programmatic registered-agent appointment management, developer self-serve access/auth docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
